name: Kakuyuugou Shoujo Ripple-chan
original_name: 核融合少女リップルちゃん
source:
Ripple-chan lives in a forest together with her parents. Her mother sends her on an errand across the forest. Many fantastic creatures and traps await her on her way.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]

A premium game for a purchaser of Harem Racer, Onnanoko Doushi, and Zetsumetsu King.
translation:
小涟漪和她的父母一起住在森林里。她的母亲派她穿过森林去执行任务。许多奇妙的生物和陷阱在路上等待着她。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]

专为《后宫赛车手》、《Onnanoko Doushi》和《Zetsumetsu King》购买者打造的高级游戏。
